, Reason for Mistake: It set C = 154 cm from the July 2023 Business Insider article, but that source reports the average height of women in the Philippines at about 150 cm (rounded). Using C = 154 led to 4097 − C = 3943 and x ≈ 563.3, whereas the correct C = 150 gives 4097 − 150 = 3947 and x ≈ 563.9.
